description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2152/32 of 05.12.2019 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a regulatory amendment to the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act. It contains an order that modifies existing regulations (specifically amending Gazette Notification No. 2152/32) regarding importation of furnace oil. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make regulatory changes, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is legal/regulatory in nature, focusing on tax/levy regulations and customs procedures.
